title: A branch that conflicts with main: Update from Main and Merge takes it to merged in one click

steps.waitFor: h1:has-text("Say how to run the playground")

steps.caption: BL-16 is approved, but its branch conflicts with main: Merge to main can't work
In its place, the step that can: Update from Main and Merge
Its agent rebases the branch onto main and resolves the conflict; the review checks it
Its agent resolved them: the part that needs you stops with one button, Approve
Then it merges, the checks first: merged into main, without a dialog
